people.role: Reeler in the worm sheds; judges the year's bolts
people.appearance: The nail of her left thumb is worn away by the reel.
people.backstory: Learned the reel from Hầu Tố Cẩm (hau_to_cam) before the burns that ended her, and is the last who remembers how the old reelers drew a thread; Tang Mộng Kiển (tang_mong_kien) asks her to judge every bolt of the year. She marks Lương Kiển Sinh's (luong_kien_sinh) bolts down a grade so no one sees how well he draws, and keeps the best thread for her own bench.

people.appearance: Wears fire-silk cuffs a rank above his own and turns his wrists to show them.
people.backstory: A Tang Điền weaver's son who reached Trúc Cơ at the looms with no master above him, only Thân Vân Cẩm (than_van_cam) as a sister of the bench; he wants fire-silk priced by the season. He sells the charring robes' off-cuts to Chiêm Lợi Châu's (chiem_loi_chau) stall and keeps the coin, while the outer gate's rice is cut by a third.

ties.note: the head, a sister of the bench

people.role: Stretches silk on the banner frames
people.appearance: The boys at the frame shed forget her name by the next day.
people.backstory: A lake girl who came for the looms and stays at the outer gate, as most Hồ Tâm girls do; she stretches silk on Mâu Tú Linh's (mau_tu_linh) banner frames and has seen the drafts of the great banner.

people.role: Feeds the worms and works the reels
people.appearance: Presses one ear to every tray he passes.
people.backstory: Feeds the worms for Tang Mộng Kiển (tang_mong_kien) and can hear a worm stop spinning across the shed; she put him on the reels beside Lương Kiển Sinh (luong_kien_sinh). He pinches the weak worms before they spin and drops them in the pit, and Lã Tiểu Tàm (la_tieu_tam) cried a week over the one she had named.

people.role: Loads the bolts at the market table in Tang Điền
people.appearance: Counts under his breath in a clerk's whisper.
people.backstory: Loads the bolts at Tang Điền for Thành Kim Toa (thanh_kim_toa), the northern ones under the palace's, and sends his share of the price home to his mother in Tang Âm. He short-counts the bolts at the table for small coin, and the loaders' wages were docked for the shortfall.

people.appearance: Burn-shiny fingertips on her right hand only.
people.backstory: The second Tang Âm girl with the Fire to set thread, after Đậu Hồng Ti (dau_hong_ti), and her rival at the bench; Thân Vân Cẩm (than_van_cam) lets her set fire only in the charring robes, and she counts the seasons. She set Đậu Hồng Ti's sleeve alight in the charring room 'by accident', and the blister is still there.

people.appearance: Stained faintly blue to the hairline, as if the vats had marked her.
people.backstory: Followed the guest dyer Nhiễm Thanh Lam (nhiem_thanh_lam) from Lam Điện to stir her vats; the pavilion does not teach her its canon, and the dyer teaches her only colours. She copies the dyer's mordants at night and sells the colours at the Lam Điện stalls, undercutting the dyer's own grandchildren.
people.exception: servant (tạp dịch) to the guest dyer: Water-rooted, not taught the lineage
